name: ui-badge
description: Bootstrap badge: solid, subtle or outline in every theme colour or a free colour, pill, link, scoped (split) like GitLab's scoped labels.

descriptions.--bs-badge-gap: Space between an icon and the text.
descriptions.--bs-badge-font-size: Font size (relative to the parent, so badges scale with headings).
descriptions.--bs-badge-color: Text colour without a theme colour (solid: the theme's contrast colour).
descriptions.--bs-badge-bg: Background without a theme colour (solid: the theme's background).
